crossRefs.note: “Behold, my servant, whom I uphold, my chosen, in whom my soul delights: I have put my Spirit on him. He will bring…
the people which I formed for myself, that they might declare my praise.
Sing, you heavens, for Yahweh has done it! Shout, you lower parts of the earth! Break out into singing, you mountains…
Behold, my servant will deal wisely. He will be exalted and lifted up, and will be very high.
Yet it pleased Yahweh to bruise him. He has caused him to suffer. When you make his soul an offering for sin, he will…
Hear now, Joshua the high priest, you and your fellows who sit before you; for they are men who are a sign: for…
While he was still speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them. Behold, a voice came out of the cloud, saying…
The angel said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for behold, I bring you good news of great joy which will be to all the…
Father, glorify your name!” Then a voice came out of the sky, saying, “I have both glorified it, and will glorify it…
When he had gone out, Jesus said, “Now the Son of Man has been glorified, and God has been glorified in him.
If God has been glorified in him, God will also glorify him in himself, and he will glorify him immediately.
“In this my Father is glorified, that you bear much fruit; and so you will be my disciples.
Jesus said these things, then lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said, “Father, the time has come. Glorify your Son…
I glorified you on the earth. I have accomplished the work which you have given me to do.
to the praise of the glory of his grace, by which he freely gave us favor in the Beloved,
who, existing in the form of God, didn’t consider equality with God a thing to be grasped,
But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: He said to me, “You are my servant, Israel, in whom I will be glorified.”
translations.bsb: He said to Me, “You are My Servant, Israel, in whom I will display My glory.”
translations.kjv: And said unto me, Thou art my servant, O Israel, in whom I will be glorified.
translations.asv: and he said unto me, Thou art my servant; Israel, in whom I will be glorified.
